curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can Jonah Hex halt Turnbull's devastating plan before the rogue officer unleashes his ultimate catastrophe?
curatedMovie.description: Commissioned by President Ulysses Grant, scarred gunslinger Jonah Hex hunts down Quentin Turnbull, a Confederate officer set on unleashing hell on earth and the man who slaughtered Hex's family.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, gritty, and suspenseful supernatural action built for a focused solo watch or casual group night.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: At a lean 81 minutes, Jimmy Hayward's fast-moving fantasy thriller fuses grit and apocalyptic stakes into a propulsive hunt fueled by pure vengeance.
